advertisers_id.description: Specific Advertiser IDs to sync. Must be populated if `syncMode` is set to `SpecificAccounts`.

sync_mode.description: Whether to sync all accounts or specific accounts. Default value: `SpecificAccounts`.

timeframe_months.description: Number of months' worth of reporting data you'd like to include in your initial sync. This cannot be modified once the connector is created. Default value: `TWELVE`.

client_id.description: `Client ID` of your Yahoo Gemini client application.

client_secret.description: `Client Secret` of your Yahoo Gemini client application.
